summary: Iteration 2 tested NEW features: Session Timer, Court Diagrams, Parent Handout, Teams + Roster grid. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass covering Team CRUD, roster add/remove/toggle, sessions_summary, user scoping (cross-user isolation), auth guards. Frontend: full flow verified end-to-end via Playwright — timer ticks at 1Hz (08:00 → 07:58 after 2.5s), pause holds value, next advances drill counter (1/6 → 2/6), reset returns to Drill 1, 6 SVG court diagrams render with aria-label 'Court diagram: ...', /programs/:id/week/:week/handout renders parent-handout-page with 6 handout drills + print button, Teams page, teams-new-btn toggles create form, team creation redirects to /teams/:id, player add creates roster-row-<pid> with W01-W10 cells + Done counter, clicking a cell fills gold+check icon and persists across reload (1/10 displayed), Nav teams-link works, program-create-team-btn and week-handout-1..10 links all present on ProgramView.
critical_code_review_comments: SessionTimer auto-advance: on timer hitting 0 it does `setDrillIdx(i => i+1); return 0;` — this leaves the interval running but `running` stays true, and the drill-change effect resets seconds to next drill's duration. This works but is subtle. Recommend adding a comment or restructuring for clarity.

Teams.jsx: 'Home Sheet' vs 'Parent Handout' label decided by program.skill_level check — this is on the ProgramView not Teams; correct behaviour but review-request wording implied both labels should share testid week-handout-N which is satisfied.

TeamDetail: `sessions` array always uses program.sessions_summary length; if program is deleted, backend returns program=null and sessions=[] — page would render empty roster grid columns; consider defensive UI messaging.
test_credentials: test1@test.com / testpass1 (existing user with programs); also registered fresh users during backend tests with TEST_ prefix emails.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests self-provision fresh users/programs/teams/players; UI test created one team + one player for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new iteration-2 features (Session Timer, Court Diagram overlays per category, Parent Handout page, Teams CRUD, Roster player+week grid) verified working end-to-end. Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_teams.py — run with `pytest -o addopts=''` to disable module-level xdist parallelism (fixtures use pytest.<attr> for cross-test sharing).
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests. Only note: pytest.ini enables xdist parallelism which broke shared pytest.<attr> state; workaround is `-o addopts=''` or refactor to class-scoped fixtures for future tests.
